epic-status-log-fixed-text: Prohibition 1: a gamelib.log line is fixed text. The TS logged the error object, so its two Epic-status lines end with a JavaScript error text ("Failed to get epic service status with TypeError: data.components is not iterable", "... with AxiosError: Request failed with status code 500") or the transport code ("Could not reach the Epic status page ( ENOTFOUND ), treating Epic as offline for this launch/install check"). A JavaScript error message is worded by the JS engine and the HTTP client, and a transport error can name the status URL. Rust logs the same prefix and the failure CATEGORY instead ("Failed to get epic service status with status(503)", "... with unexpected-response"; "Could not reach the Epic status page, treating Epic as offline for this launch/install check"), never a URL, a query or a transport message. The result, the notification and the request are the same as the golden.
